notes: Forecasts use the Step 4 feature panel and nested OLS, refitted monthly on the preceding window with a horizon embargo.
tail: unit signal sign(forecast) when |forecast| exceeds the training quantile for tail_fraction, else 0.
continuous: forecast divided by the same training threshold, clipped to [-1, 1].
The position is the mean of the last H hourly signals (H staggered tranches held H hours each).
Hourly P&L = position x next-hour perp return - position x funding settled in that hour - cost x |position change|.
The primary variant was named before the backtest was run; all others are reported as sensitivities.
baseline and baseline_positioning were added after the first run to attribute the combined model's performance; they are attribution checks, not candidates.
recent_* metrics cover 2025-06 to 2026-05; the attribution drops each positioning feature, then all three long/short ratio features, from baseline_positioning.
